title: US single release: Got To Get You Into My Life | 1976
content:
The Beatles’ 1966 song ‘Got To Get You Into My Life’ was released as a single in the US on 31 May 1976, with ‘Helter Skelter’ on the b-side.

It was released ahead of the compilation album Rock ‘N’ Roll Music, one of several reworkings of The Beatles’ back catalogue by EMI and Capitol Records.

The single was also released in Australia, Germany and Japan, and topped the charts in Canada.
